publication_policy: candidate-only; do not publish without curation

signals.title: Can civic-tech wishes be converted into higher-quality neutral Problem Packets?
signals.observed_condition: Civic Tech Taiwan currently exposes a project wish pool that asks contributors to state a project, a technology-to-pain-point formulation, shortcomings of current tools, needed capabilities, and progress.

metadata.hypothesis: A reviewed Problem Packet may reduce premature solution framing and improve solver comprehension compared with a raw wish/project brief.
next_checks: Confirm terms/rights for any individual wish used in a study.
Select a small public sample without implying platform endorsement.
Create paired raw-brief and Problem-Packet versions.

signals.title: Investigate recurrent Taoyuan accident corridors before prescribing pedestrian interventions
signals.observed_condition: Taoyuan publishes A1/A2 accident records with time, road/intersection and coordinates, plus separate accident-hotspot, sidewalk-management, and real-time roadway datasets that could support candidate-corridor discovery.

metadata.hypothesis: Joined public data may identify corridors worth field investigation, but cannot by itself establish that sidewalk geometry, signal timing, exposure, visibility, or behavior is causal.
next_checks: Inspect joinability and time coverage across datasets.
Ask a transport/domain reviewer to challenge the formulation.
Collect representative observations before proposing intervention.

signals.title: Represent an application-gated public-interest problem without leaking restricted source data
signals.observed_condition: The 2026 Presidential Hackathon provides agricultural vehicle imagery to participating teams by application/review for uses such as image recognition, facility inventory, rural-road/environment analysis and disaster assessment.

metadata.hypothesis: A public Problem Packet can expose purpose, constraints, contribution paths and success criteria while keeping the underlying application-gated dataset locator/access outside the anonymous public surface.
next_checks: Do not infer a specific agricultural problem from dataset availability alone.
Use a hypothetical or partner-approved task for the access-control test.
Verify that public exports redact restricted locators and rights-sensitive metadata.
Compare contributor comprehension with and without direct dataset access.
